thread:
alex_ross: Drafting an RFC for the Optimize Toolkit recommendations (batching, caching, quantization). TL;DR: propose opinionated defaults + per-customer tuning hooks + rollout plan. Link: https://redwood.internal/rfc/optimize-heuristics (WIP)

maria_k: thanks Alex — can you call out customer-driven asks up front? enterprise teams keep asking for predictable tail latency and an easy knob to prioritize accuracy over cost.

samir_p: putting some numbers in the draft: target 95th p50 p95 latency buckets per model family, target token cost reductions vs baseline (FP16) ~25% w/ int8 quant + cache, and cold-start latency <120ms for short-chat style (<128 tokens). These are goals not guarantees.

irene_cheng: acceptance criteria proposal:
- Bench harness reproduces 3 workload archetypes (chat, longform, embeddings).
- End-to-end QoS: p95 latency under SLA for 90% of runs on Dedicated.
- Quality regression guardrails: automated eval on held prompt set with max 2% metric drift (ROUGE/embedding-sim).
- Rollout strategy validated in canary with traffic shaping and auto-fallback.

noah_park: what about edge cases: mixed-batch with streaming, partial KV cache hits across model variants, and prompt-injected system tokens? need explicit handling. Also: how do we expose the "accuracy vs cost" slider in the API/console?

anya_q: QA: We should add fuzz tests for malformed cache keys, and tests that simulate KV corruption — ensure safe fallback to non-cached path. Also add load tests for worst-case sequence lengths.

alex_ross: good points. I added a short config example for the default profile in the RFC — feedback welcome.

alex_ross: ```
# example optimize profile: balanced
optimize_profile: balanced
batching:
  enabled: true
  max_batch_size: 64
  latency_slo_ms: 50
  dynamic_batching: true
cache:
  enabled: true
  prefix_kv: true
  ttl_seconds: 3600
quantization:
  strategy: int8
  per_channel: true
  calibrate_on_deploy: false
```

maria_k: config looks reasonable. For enterprise, add a "strict_latency" profile that disables large batches and forces cold-start pre-warming.

samir_p: decision needed: do we auto-quantize model variants in Hosted, or only provide recommended quantized artifacts and let Dedicated/private choose? My preference: Hosted = auto-apply recommended quant artifacts with opt-out; Dedicated/private = let ops opt-in. Rationale: reduce friction for PLG users but keep control for enterprise.

irene_cheng: acceptance criteria should include a one-click revert for quantized deployments and a quality/regression alert threshold tied to daily evals. If drift > threshold, automatically rollback.

noah_park: rollout plan sketch: stage 1 internal + alpha customers (2 weeks), stage 2 wider beta with feature flag and canary ramping (4 weeks), stage 3 GA with console UI and docs (2 weeks). Also need billing telemetry to attribute token savings.

deploy-bot: CI: rfc/optimize-heuristics -- unit tests: 42 passed, integration: 6/8 (2 flaky failures: cache-ttl test, longseq perf).

alex_ross: noted flaky tests, will triage. Next steps:
- Samir: capture decision matrix for auto-quantize (due EOW).

- Maria: collect top 3 customer asks about latency/accuracy by Mon.

- Anya: add fuzz and KV-corruption tests to CI.
